fontScope: All Han in the three new cards, all comparison identifiers and explicit mnemonic/radical components; not every legacy comparison article body.

memory.peakScope: Verifier Python process, including its monitor thread; not subprocess peaks.
memory.additionalChecks: Before each file and each streamed chunk; signal interruption on a sampled breach.

limits: Mechanical signed-inventory, finite pair/scan coverage, retained local bytes, attributed excerpt and actual bounded font-cmap verification. Does not certify pair judgments, historical execution/manual reading depth, rendered fallback, native/device, independent review, whole-set or publication acceptance.
